page.notes: Marginal note "n" at the top right, beside the first lines of the page, reads: "Gregor. in Psal.7. Poenit. in illa verba, [Auditam fac, &c.]". Uncertain readings: "misericordiâ" (the final vowel's mark may be a macron or circumflex); "ejus?]" (the mark after "ejus" could be a question mark or colon). The opening word "gnum" is a fragment from the previous line and is kept as printed. The faint text on the right side of the page is show-through and is left out. Long s is normalised to s throughout. The "&" in the final paragraph should read "&" as printed.
